newsitem.title: CHINA: China says no foreign journalists at Deng funeral.
newsitem.headline: China says no foreign journalists at Deng funeral.

text.p: China's Foreign Ministry announced on Thursday that no foreign journalists would be permitted to cover the funeral of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, who died on Wednesday.
All regular news briefings would be cancelled until February 27, the Foreign Ministry said in a statement, in an indication that Deng's funeral will be held within a week.
The funeral of Chairman Mao Zedong was held nine days after his death on September 9, 1976.
China would make no arrangements for foreign journalists to cover Deng's funeral or other mourning activities, the Foreign Ministry said.
No foreign journalists or reporters from Hong Kong, Macau or Taiwan would be given permission to come to China, it said.
